mapper.insert: INSERT INTO consultation (user_id, symptom, transferred, pharmacist_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{symptom}, #{transferred}, #{pharmacistId})
INSERT INTO consultation_message (consultation_id, sender_type, content, ai_source, confidence) VALUES (#{consultationId}, #{senderType}, #{content}, #{aiSource}, #{confidence})
mapper.select: SELECT id, consultation_id, sender_type, content, ai_source, confidence, created_at FROM consultation_message WHERE consultation_id = #{consultationId} ORDER BY id
